episode_summary: In this episode, D.J. Paris discusses how real estate agents can leverage AI to uncover hidden business opportunities within their existing contacts. He introduces five actionable AI strategies to enhance prospecting, improve client communication, and optimize time management. Listeners are encouraged to register for a live webinar to learn these strategies in detail.
